toolDetailDescription.enUS: Choose which verified provider Pi Desktop should use for Skills, Plugins, Agent commands, and project operations.
toolDetailDescription.zhCN: 选择 Pi Desktop 应用于技能、插件、Agent 命令和项目操作的已验证工具来源。

toolDiscoveryPrivacy.enUS: Scanning does not run shell profiles or access the network. Pi Desktop does not modify the system PATH, shell profile, or registry.
toolDiscoveryPrivacy.zhCN: 扫描不会执行 shell profile 或访问网络。Pi Desktop 不会修改系统 PATH、shell profile 或注册表。

toolDownloadPrivacy.enUS: Managed installs contact the displayed official source and expose your IP address, platform, and architecture. Downloads stay inside Pi Desktop data.
toolDownloadPrivacy.zhCN: 托管安装会连接页面所示官方来源，并暴露 IP 地址、平台和架构。下载内容仅保存在 Pi Desktop 数据目录。
